# Ready for 2026.11

Version 1.3.1 prepares the integration for Home Assistant 2026.11. Your feeds look and behave exactly as before.

## Upkeep

- **The feed library follows Home Assistant.** The integration asked for exactly the version of the feed library that Home Assistant's own Feed Reader ships. Once Home Assistant moves to a newer one, that exact request would no longer match. It now asks for that version or newer, so it keeps using the copy Home Assistant already has.
- **Installing from the Marketplace.** Home Assistant 2026.11 replaces HACS with the built-in Marketplace. The README now explains how to add this integration there as a custom repository, and in HACS on earlier versions.

Under the hood, the setup and options dialogs now use Home Assistant's current validation library directly.

## Requirements

Unchanged: Home Assistant 2026.9.3 or newer.
